title: M3: every saved clip exported as an .alc named with its section letter, length and key
description:
## Purpose
Every clip saved with a sample (yours, automatic markup's `sec-A1`, `loop-1`, `shot-3`, `hold-2`, curated ones) is exported as an `.alc` in a folder beside the sample, named so the DAW's browser reads like a crate: section letter, length and key first, then the clip's name. Dragging one in gives exactly that region, warped and in tune.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  S["Thunderer.mp3 + manifest
clips: sec-A1, loop-1, shot-3, riff"] -->|apricity export --sidecars| F["Thunderer.mp3 clips/"]
  F --> a["A-16bars-Bb sec-A1.alc"]
  F --> b["A-1bar-Bb loop-1.alc"]
  F --> c["B-1beat-Eb shot-3.alc"]
  F --> d["A-2bars-Bb riff.alc"]
```

## Naming (decided here, recorded in design/daw-sidecars.md §Naming)
`<section letter>-<length>-<key> <clip name>.alc`: the section the clip starts in (omitted when the sample has no sections, e.g. drum stems); length in bars when whole bars, else beats (`1bar`, `4bars`, `1beat`, `6beats`), omitted for unwarped samples; key from key over time where most of the clip lies, chord-style (`Bb`, `Fm`), omitted when the sample is unpitched or its key is weak. apricitus-5562e0 (browsable clip folder, kits) reuses this rule and the `.alc` writer instead of defining its own.

## Scope
Folder layout, naming, region and warp settings per clip, retired clips skipped, stale Apricity-written files removed, edited ones kept; `--no-clips` to skip.

## Out of scope
Kits as `.adg` and crate folders (apricitus-5562e0); importing clips back from `.alc` as saved clips.

## Definition of Done
1. `features/daw/export_clips.feature` in the M2 CLI runner; green.
2. Rust (`apricity-daw::names`, `export`, `apricity-cli`). No Python.
3. No schema change (warp mode is derived, not stored).
4. `--no-clips`; report lines per clip; errors located.
6. `design/daw-sidecars.md` §Naming.
7. `docs/tools.md` and `docs/concepts.md` (Automatic markup) updated.
8. Web need filed (label `web`).
9. `safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw -p apricity-cli`; manual check in the DAW's browser.
10, 11. Log; `feat(<task id>)`; nothing breaking.

## Dependencies
Blocked by M2 (the command) and M1 (`.alc` writer). Relates to apricitus-5562e0.
